WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Guide to the live game, 1 to 60. Mechanics come from Blizzard's posts and the client with its hotfixes. Talent builds are the guide sites' own, named and dated, and every one of them was published on or before November 4, before the November 12 changes; none has been revised since. The rotation is the one Wowhead, Icy Veins and WoWSims' model share. Nothing here rests on a raid log: no raid opens until December 9. Talent levels assume no TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points. Legacy perk, which starts your points up to five levels earlier without raising the 51-point cap. The StormstrikeStormstrikeLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost8% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration12 secInstantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec., Maelstrom WeaponMaelstrom WeaponTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantWhen you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec. and Windfury WeaponWindfury WeaponLevel 30 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost90 ManaImbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 104 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes. tooltips read the base client and lag the November 12 hotfix, so where a tooltip differs from the text here, trust the text.

What Enhancement is for

A slow two-hander with a weapon imbue that lasts an hour. Rockbiter WeaponRockbiter WeaponSpell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost15 ManaImbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 49 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes. carries you to 30. Windfury WeaponWindfury WeaponLevel 30 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost90 ManaImbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 104 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes. arrives at 30: each hit has a 20% chance of two extra attacks. StormstrikeStormstrikeLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost8% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration12 secInstantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec. arrives at 25: 100% weapon damage on an 8-second cooldown, and +20% on your next Lightning BoltLightning BoltLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 10Cast1.5 sec castCost15 ManaRange30 yd rangeCasts a bolt of lightning at the target for 15 to 18 Nature damage., Chain LightningChain LightningLevel 32 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4Cast2.5 sec castCost245 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownHurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 208 to 236 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets. or Earth ShockEarth ShockLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost30 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration2 secInstantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 21 to 24 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat. against that target.

The November 12 changes pulled the spec back toward its weapon. Blizzard's reason: the beta changes "caused Enhancement to favor Spell Power and Intellect gear too heavily" and "pushed Enhancement away from Windfury, which we believe should remain at the heart of the specialization's fantasy and gameplay." What changed:

  • StormstrikeStormstrikeLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost8% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration12 secInstantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec. deals 100% weapon damage (was 150%) on an 8-second cooldown (was 6).
  • Mental DexterityMental DexterityTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect. converts 33/66/100% of Intellect to attack power (was 50/100/150%).
  • Maelstrom WeaponMaelstrom WeaponTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantWhen you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec. gives 20% per charge at every rank, and procs 6/7/8/9/10 times a minute by rank (was 20 a minute at any rank).
  • Weapon imbues and weapon totems now work together. A Shaman with Windfury WeaponWindfury WeaponLevel 30 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost90 ManaImbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 104 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes. also benefits from Windfury TotemWindfury TotemLevel 32 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost115 ManaDuration300 secSummons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 95 extra melee attack power. Lasts 300 sec., and can proc both.

Mana is the limiter while levelling. Both guide sites say so. Icy Veins lists "Extremely high Mana costs" as the first weakness, and Wowhead's levelling page advises that "If mana is an issue, you can stop using your Shocks and just let your auto attacks carry."

The sources agree it is the solo levelling tree. Wowhead's Restoration levelling page tells solo players to "look to play Enhancement instead", and its Elemental levelling page recommends a hybrid built in the Enhancement tree. Icy Veins rates the spec 4 of 5 overall, 4 for levelling, 4 for dungeons and 4.5 for mobility; a levelling score measures solo kill speed.

Shamans cannot dual wield in Forever. Wowhead: "There won't be any official support for dual-wielding, and the skill has been removed in this version of the game." Buy one big two-hander.

Stat priority

  1. Weapon DPS on a slow two-hander. Icy Veins suggests 3.3 to 3.8 speed
  2. Hit, to 8% for melee, and Expertise, 6.5% in Wowhead's figure
  3. Strength and attack power
  4. Intellect
  5. Critical strike, Haste and Agility
  6. Spell Power
  7. Spirit and Stamina

Strength over Intellect is Blizzard's position, and the guide sites have not caught up. Blizzard, November 6: "We plan to make changes so that Strength is always their strongest stat", and "Enhancement Shaman players who are leveling up will want to collect Strength and Attack Power gear from now on." Wowhead's stat page (November 3) and Icy Veins' (November 4) both still rank Intellect above Strength. Both predate the change.

The arithmetic behind it. A point of Strength is 2 attack power. A point of Intellect is 1 attack power through Mental DexterityMental DexterityTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect. 3/3, plus 15 Mana, some spell crit, and spell damage through Mental QuicknessMental QuicknessTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantIncreases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.. Before November 12 it was 1.5 attack power. Blizzard still expects "some Intellect and/or Spell Power" on your best items. The order of items 4 to 7 above is our own reading; no source has published a list since the change.

Hit and Expertise first is the one thing both sites and WoWSims' weights agree on. A missed two-hander swing is a long wait.

The class quest weapon was changed to match. Rage of the StormRage of the StormItem is the two-handed mace from The Tempest's Weapons, the chain that follows the level-30 Air totem quest. Since November 10 it has 16 Strength where it had Intellect and swings at 3.6 where it swung at 3.2, and it adds 10% to StormstrikeStormstrikeLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost8% of base ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration12 secInstantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec. damage. Icy Veins calls the chain "Difficult at Level 30": it needs a Razorfen Kraul run, drops from zones around 35 to 40, and ends in waves of elites.

On Enhancement tanking

Blizzard sanctions it, in one shape only. Of the redesigned Spirit WeaponsSpirit WeaponsTalentCastInstantGives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active., the deep dive says it "will help Enhancement Shaman manage their threat now that their damage is competitive, while also retaining their unique ability to generate high threat and serve as a temporary tank in small group gameplay". Improved StormstrikeImproved StormstrikeTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantWhen you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry. exists partly to give you "more active Stormstrike usage when serving as a temporary tank."

Spirit WeaponsSpirit WeaponsTalentCastInstantGives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active. is the mechanism. The tooltip: "Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter WeaponRockbiter WeaponSpell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost15 ManaImbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 49 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes. is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active." You tank in Rockbiter and drop it to go back to damage. There is no taunt and no defensive cooldown. Your survival talents are AnticipationAnticipationTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your chance to dodge by an additional 6%., 6% Dodge at 3/3, and ToughnessToughnessTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your Stamina by 10%., 10% Stamina at 5/5.

One published guide goes further. A community guide hosted on Wowhead, by Caperfin and last changed November 10, tanks dungeons with a shield, Rockbiter WeaponRockbiter WeaponSpell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost15 ManaImbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 49 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes. and Fire NovaFire NovaLevel 12 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost65 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly inflicts 32 to 38 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem. for area threat. It publishes two builds, 17/23/11 and 0/20/31, and both are legal on the current tree. It is one author's method and nothing in our evidence tests it. Icy Veins' class overview stops at "off-tanking duties, or serve as tanks for dungeons in a pinch." Blizzard names no dungeon or raid tanking role for Shaman.

At level 60

Sourced: the builds above, the shared priority list, and Blizzard's statement that Strength gear is the intended direction. Icy Veins notes the spec "relies a lot on a Paladin's Judgement of Wisdom to sustain a full rotation" in raids. Every melee group wants a Windfury TotemWindfury TotemLevel 32 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost115 ManaDuration300 secSummons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party or raid members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with 95 extra melee attack power. Lasts 300 sec., which any Shaman provides.

Not known: how the spec performs after November 12. No raid opens until December 9, so there is no raid log, and no guide site has rewritten its build or stat page since the change. Blizzard said it changed the spec before the raid on purpose, so players would not win "highly contested items that could become much less valuable after a later change." Blizzard also tunes classes on Tuesdays "if necessary", so check the date on anything you read.
